novel_features.name: Shared event album
novel_features.description: Create or update a reviewable shared event album from explicit Immich search filters.
novel_features.rationale: Combines search, album creation, asset membership, and optional sharing through real Immich endpoints.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it when an agent needs to make a shareable event collection without manually copying asset IDs.

novel_features.name: Duplicate resolution plan
novel_features.description: Preview native duplicate groups and a deterministic keeper proposal without changing assets.
novel_features.rationale: Uses the native Duplicates API rather than pretending to detect duplicates locally.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it before any destructive duplicate cleanup.

novel_features.name: Duplicate resolution apply
novel_features.description: Resolve selected native duplicate groups only after an explicit apply confirmation.
novel_features.rationale: Re-fetches groups and calls the real resolve endpoint with a reviewable plan.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it only after reviewing a duplicate plan.

novel_features.name: Recurring-month people finder
novel_features.description: Find one or two people across past Julys using real people and metadata search endpoints.
novel_features.rationale: Turns a recurring personal library question into a bounded date-and-person query.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it for questions such as photos of me and Dad from past Julys.

novel_features.name: Memory review queue
novel_features.description: List recent native memories with their dates and asset counts for an intentional review.
novel_features.rationale: Uses Immich memories and memory-statistics endpoints, not generated prose.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it to revisit what Immich surfaced without paging through the web UI.

novel_features.name: Favorites/archive review
novel_features.description: Review bounded favorite and archived asset search results without mutating the library.
novel_features.rationale: Uses metadata search with explicit filters and preserves a safe read-only first step.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it to curate favorites and archived material deliberately.

novel_features.name: Stack hygiene review
novel_features.description: Inspect native stacks for empty, singleton, and unusually large groups without changing them.
novel_features.rationale: Uses native stack list/detail endpoints and reports deterministic facts.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it to understand burst and RAW/JPEG grouping before editing a stack.

novel_features.name: Partner and job health
novel_features.description: Report partner-sharing and worker-queue facts from the configured Immich server.
novel_features.rationale: Combines the real partners, jobs, and queue APIs into a bounded health view.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it when a self-hosted photo library feels stale or a shared library is not behaving as expected.

narrative.headline: Agent-native control and careful personal-library rituals for a self-hosted Immich instance.
narrative.value_prop: Covers Immich's official v3 API, the upload/import strengths of immich-go, and the broad raw operations of ImmichMCP, then adds safe personal workflows for events, duplicate cleanup, family time queries, memories, stacks, partners, and jobs.
narrative.auth_narrative: Set IMMICH_BASE_URL to the API root of your own Immich server and IMMICH_API_KEY to an API key with only the permissions your commands need. The CLI sends the key as x-api-key and never prints it.

quickstart.comment: Verify the configured self-hosted URL and API-key prerequisites without a request.
Preview a shared event-album plan before changing the library.
Review native duplicate groups before resolving anything.
Check partner and queue facts on the current Immich server.

troubleshoots.fix: Create an Immich API key with the least permissions required and export it as IMMICH_API_KEY.

troubleshoots.symptom: The self-hosted server cannot be reached
troubleshoots.fix: Set IMMICH_BASE_URL to the API root reachable from this machine, then run immich-pp-cli doctor.
Run the corresponding preview command first, then supply the command's explicit apply flag only after reviewing the IDs.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI for your own or a delegated self-hosted Immich library: finding and sharing event photos, safely dealing with duplicates, browsing people/time memories, and checking the health of the host.
anti_triggers: Do not use it against an Immich instance you are not authorized to access.
Do not run duplicate resolution or asset deletion without reviewing the preview output.
Do not expect it to replace a local backup of your original photos.
